pattern: IM-T07 closure: guarantee return fixed the fault at no charge and the tenant confirms after a week of hot washes; close the reopened job and release the original invoice (EX-07 done right)
notes: Base 042-repair-failed-recurs (events 001-032 unchanged) plus appended events 033-037 (Mon 4 March 2024: reopened as a return visit; guarantee request to Lantern at no further charge, with the 28/02 invoice of GBP 75.11 on hold until the return visit is complete; landlord Mercer told; tenant told; hold Waiting for Provider), 038 (Tue 5 March: return booked Wed 6 March 10am-12pm), 039 (Wed 6 March 12:40: work result, loose crimp connector on the element terminal re-terminated, tested 60°C and 90°C, no charge under guarantee), 040 (agency asks the tenant to confirm after a few hot washes and keeps the job open), 041 (Mon 11 March 08:31: tenant confirms four or five 60°C washes, heating properly every time). Total events 41, cut after 041. The job here is reopened and still has a held invoice, so it is not a message on an already-closed job. Expected: record the result, tell the landlord the fault is fixed at no extra cost, release the original GBP 75.11 invoice for payment now the fix has held, and close the job with the tenant's confirmation; no new charge, no escalation.
